title: Plate
description: A registration assignment over a time interval. A plate is ONE MUTABLE ATTRIBUTE of a vehicle, never its identity: re-plating opens a new interval on the same IVID, which is why adverse history cannot be shed by changing plates. Intervals are closed, never deleted. NO OWNER FIELD EXISTS, BY CONSTRUCTION.

format_code.description: Which configured plate format matched. Formats are configuration, never hardcoded.

region_code.description: Coarse region only. Never a precise location.

valid_to.description: Null while the interval is open. Closing an interval never deletes it.
